# 三部律抄

**ID:** T2793
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 律部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2793

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Dunhuang Vinaya excerpts-collection drawing on three Vinaya schools (三部 *sānbù*) — likely the *Sìfēn*, *Shísòng*, and *Sēngqí*.

**Abstract**

The text presents comparative Vinaya material drawn from three of the four canonical Chinese Vinayas, providing the late-Tang Dunhuang reader with a synoptic resource for cross-school Vinaya comparison. Such cross-school Vinaya scholarship was characteristic of Dàoxuān's Nánshān approach and is attested in this Dunhuang fragment as a wider feature of late-Tang Vinaya studies.
